answer: Operator Exposure Ledger. Each identity is bound to a bridge address whose withdrawals are delayed by a rolling 30-day window. If a cluster of wallets exhibits correlated timing or shared funding roots, the ledger freezes all bridge withdrawals tied to the common operator and routes a fraction of pending balances to a meadow of whistleblowers who flagged the cluster. An attacker spreading N sybils pays N times the delay risk plus forfeiture of the operator's pooled float, a comet that grows with each detected duplicate.
